title: Finite Gibbs-ensemble / isolated-response and Gaussian two-point boundary

source.citation: Giustino, Rev. Mod. Phys. 89, 015003 (2017), DOI 10.1103/RevModPhys.89.015003, Eq145 and footnote3
source.scope: FD/Bose definitions and finite-energy response context. No imported static-ensemble equivalence; all reported fixture identities are independently checked against CAR/Fock/Gibbs definitions.

units.energy: arbitrary E0, not eV or material energies
units.noise_line_weight: dimensionless; Fourier noise weight 2pi W delta(omega-Delta/hbar)

state_scope: Three number-conserving noninteracting orbitals, exact eight-dimensional Fock space. Reusable response/curvature formulas are used on stationary diagonal grandcanonical quasi-free Gibbs states: physical FD occupations at a common beta/mu, equal within exactly degenerate energy subspaces. They are not a response license for arbitrary nonequilibrium occupations or for a finite canonical state inferred by independent FD factors.
preregistered_ensembles: isolated unitary retarded linear response of that stationary state
Legendre free energy at fixed mean N, mu(x) solved independently

reading_guide.registration: registration.json is frozen before code execution; source manifests and original-byte tar snapshots precede each generation's execution.
reading_guide.response: Complete ordered complex cross channels are retained. The +i/hbar commutator convention responds to delta H=-x B. Detailed balance and symmetrized FDT are line-resolved; at zero frequency the finite covariance is checked directly rather than multiplying a zero spectral commutator by a divergent coth.
reading_guide.curvature: receipt.json records exact isolated, GC, mean-number Legendre, and canonical matrices and independent expm free-energy derivatives at three preregistered steps. In the nondegenerate fixture mean N is exactly1, so the Legendre/canonical distinction is not an unequal-mean artifact.
reading_guide.screening: A quadratic-action counterterm matches only the curvature already included in the calibrated stiffness under that same action/ensemble. The receipt includes both algebraic and independent full-Fock free-energy-action derivatives exposing an isolated-static counterterm incorrectly inserted into a GC-calibrated action. No finite population relaxation law is supplied.
reading_guide.bath: Positive-gap modes reproduce only connected two-point noise and retarded response with complex couplings. Exactly zero gaps retain covariance without a commutator. The nonzero fourth occupation cumulants expose a higher-moment Gaussian identification as false. The bath proof does not construct a complete DFT model.

limitations: Evaluated exact fixtures, not a universal theorem over all spectra
No numerical smoothing to physical-temperature identification
No Gaussian higher-moment or nonlinear fermion-dynamics equivalence
No irreversible lifetime from a finite recurrent bath
No material, coherence, nuclear, or full-campaign completion claim

See source-generation0002-corrections.json and source-generation0003-corrections.json; no scientific tolerance was loosened.
